title: Flask debug mode enabled in __main__ entrypoint
evidence: app.py:148 app.run(host="127.0.0.1", port=8000, debug=True) — debug=True exposes the interactive Werkzeug debugger
suggestion: Default debug to False (or read from an env var) so an accidental production launch does not expose the debugger

title: PUT /books/{id} is a full replace, not a partial update
evidence: app.py:108-130 update_book runs _validate_book, so title and author are required on every PUT and omitted year/isbn are set to NULL
suggestion: Acceptable per spec (which says 'update a book'); consider PATCH semantics if partial updates are desired
